// One-shot golden-fixture generator for claude-worker pmlr.py (8f item 10;
// VT1 2026-09-03 adds ticks_v3). Bytes come from the REAL core-io
// PmlrWriter so the Python reader is pinned to the Rust writer.
//
// The writer stamps header version 3 since VT1. The v2 flavors are the
// same slot bytes with the header version patched to 2 — byte-identical
// to what the v2 writer produced, because every v3-only byte (Tick
// offsets 49..64) is zero for `Tick::new` and every other kind is
// unchanged. The v1 flavor additionally fills Tick bytes 48..64 with 0xAA
// (v1's undefined padding; no v1 writer exists anymore — mirrors the
// core-io reader-test pattern).
use core_types::{
    make_symbol_id, Fill, Price, Qty, Side, Tick, VenueId, TICK_FLAG_STALE,
    TICK_FLAG_VENUE_TIME_SENTINEL,
};

fn patch_version(bytes: &mut [u8], version: u16) {
    bytes[4..6].copy_from_slice(&version.to_le_bytes());
}

fn main() {
    let out = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::args().nth(1).expect("usage: gen <outdir>"));
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&out).unwrap();
    let epoch_ns: u64 = 1_755_216_000_000_000_000;

    let pm7 = make_symbol_id(VenueId::Polymarket, 7);
    let hl_yes = make_symbol_id(VenueId::Hyperliquid, 10_810);
    let hl_no = make_symbol_id(VenueId::Hyperliquid, 10_811);

    // ---- ticks_v2.pmlr (SlotKind::Tick = 0): v3 writer, header patched to 2 ----
    {
        let p = out.join("ticks_v2.pmlr");
        let mut w = core_io::PmlrWriter::open(&p, core_io::SlotKind::Tick, epoch_ns).unwrap();
        let ticks = [
            Tick::new(1_000_000_000, VenueId::Polymarket, pm7, 1, Price(490_000), Qty(100_000_000), Price(510_000), Qty(50_000_000)),
            Tick::new(2_000_000_000, VenueId::Polymarket, pm7, 2, Price(500_000), Qty(90_000_000), Price(520_000), Qty(40_000_000)),
            Tick::new(2_500_000_000, VenueId::Hyperliquid, hl_yes, 11, Price(600_000), Qty(10_000_000), Price(620_000), Qty(10_000_000)),
            Tick::new(3_000_000_000, VenueId::Hyperliquid, hl_no, 12, Price(380_000), Qty(10_000_000), Price(400_000), Qty(10_000_000)),
        ];
        for i in 0..ticks.len() {
            w.append(&ticks[i]).unwrap();
        }
        w.flush().unwrap();
        drop(w);
        let mut bytes = std::fs::read(&p).unwrap();
        patch_version(&mut bytes, 2);
        std::fs::write(&p, &bytes).unwrap();
    }

    // ---- ticks_v3.pmlr (VT1): venue time + flags carried per slot ----
    {
        let mut w =
            core_io::PmlrWriter::open(out.join("ticks_v3.pmlr"), core_io::SlotKind::Tick, epoch_ns)
                .unwrap();
        let ticks = [
            // OKX: direct venue stamp, fresh.
            Tick::new_stamped(1_000_000_000, VenueId::Okx, make_symbol_id(VenueId::Okx, 1), 1, Price(76_000_000_000), Qty(1_000_000), Price(76_000_100_000), Qty(2_000_000), 1_755_216_000_071, 0),
            // OKX: direct venue stamp, STALE (feed lagged past the venue threshold).
            Tick::new_stamped(2_000_000_000, VenueId::Okx, make_symbol_id(VenueId::Okx, 1), 2, Price(76_000_000_000), Qty(1_500_000), Price(76_000_100_000), Qty(2_000_000), 1_755_216_000_400, TICK_FLAG_STALE),
            // Binance spot: stamp inherited from the aggTrade sentinel, fresh.
            Tick::new_stamped(3_000_000_000, VenueId::Binance, 7, 3, Price(75_999_990_000), Qty(3_000_000), Price(76_000_000_000), Qty(100_000), 1_755_216_002_900, TICK_FLAG_VENUE_TIME_SENTINEL),
            // Binance spot: sentinel-inherited AND stale (both bits).
            Tick::new_stamped(4_000_000_000, VenueId::Binance, 7, 4, Price(75_999_990_000), Qty(3_100_000), Price(76_000_000_000), Qty(90_000), 1_755_216_002_950, TICK_FLAG_STALE | TICK_FLAG_VENUE_TIME_SENTINEL),
            // Venue time unknown (v2 shape written by a v3 writer).
            Tick::new(5_000_000_000, VenueId::Polymarket, pm7, 5, Price(490_000), Qty(100_000_000), Price(510_000), Qty(50_000_000)),
        ];
        for i in 0..ticks.len() {
            w.append(&ticks[i]).unwrap();
        }
        w.flush().unwrap();
    }

    // ---- fills_v2.pmlr (SlotKind::Fill = 2): v3 writer, header patched to 2 ----
    {
        let p = out.join("fills_v2.pmlr");
        let mut w = core_io::PmlrWriter::open(&p, core_io::SlotKind::Fill, epoch_ns).unwrap();
        let fills = [
            Fill::new(1_100_000_000, pm7, Side::Bid, Price(480_000), Qty(20_000_000), 101),
            Fill::new(1_200_000_000, pm7, Side::Bid, Price(500_000), Qty(10_000_000), 102),
            Fill::new(1_300_000_000, pm7, Side::Ask, Price(520_000), Qty(15_000_000), 103),
            Fill::new(2_600_000_000, hl_yes, Side::Bid, Price(600_000), Qty(8_000_000), 104),
            Fill::new(3_100_000_000, hl_no, Side::Bid, Price(390_000), Qty(5_000_000), 105),
        ];
        for i in 0..fills.len() {
            w.append(&fills[i]).unwrap();
        }
        w.flush().unwrap();
        drop(w);
        let mut bytes = std::fs::read(&p).unwrap();
        patch_version(&mut bytes, 2);
        std::fs::write(&p, &bytes).unwrap();
    }

    // ---- ticks_v1.pmlr: v2 bytes, header version -> 1, v1-garbage bytes ----
    {
        let mut bytes = std::fs::read(out.join("ticks_v2.pmlr")).unwrap();
        patch_version(&mut bytes, 1);
        let n = (bytes.len() - 64) / 64;
        for i in 0..n {
            let base = 64 + i * 64;
            // Tick offsets 48 (venue, v2-only) .. 64 (tail pad): undefined in v1.
            for b in &mut bytes[base + 48..base + 64] {
                *b = 0xAA;
            }
        }
        std::fs::write(out.join("ticks_v1.pmlr"), &bytes).unwrap();
    }

    println!("fixtures written to {}", out.display());
}
